issue.title: Subscriptions album under bank: seed discretionary charges, link bank rows, propose price and candidate findings
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-kd.7 (bank epic wrap-up, note #1) and specified in the bank epic plan
`plan:202611/bank_daily_acknowledgment.md`, section "Follow-up: the subscriptions album".
Reviewer decision carried from that plan: **subscriptions_scope = discretionary**.

Scope (from the plan):

- Create the album with `bob albums create`: parent `bank`, stem `subscriptions`, noun
  `subscription`, emoji 🔁, title `Subscriptions`, summary "Everything that charges us on
  repeat, and whether it still earns its keep.", `index_facets: [amount, cadence, category]`.
- Fields: `status` (`to_cancel: ✂️ To cancel`, `active: 💚 Active`, `cancelled: 🚫 Cancelled`,
  actionable group first); `amount` (number, min 0, required); `cadence` (`monthly`,
  `yearly`, required); `payee` (suggest; the bank-row payee it shows up as); `category`
  (suggest); `renews` (date); `url`.
- Seed only keep-or-cancel charges from `old_recur.md`'s active rows (discretionary
  scope: mortgage, student loans, car insurance, utilities, and Kelly's salary stay bank
  categories/rules). Then de-zorg `old_recur.md` into a `legacy_recur` notebook under
  `cash` following the `eat.md` recipe (keep every block ID; rewrite or report every
  inbound link).
- Link existing bank rows to their records (`[[subscriptions/<stem>|🔁]]`) so learned
  naming carries the link to future imports.
- `bob bank check` proposes, never creates: `bank_subscription_price` (linked row amount
  differs from the record's `amount`) and `bank_subscription_candidate` (3+ charges from
  one merchant ~30 or ~365 days apart with no linked record).
- Point `cash.md ^audit-monthly-subscriptions` at the album.

Depends on bob-cli-k3 (albums: `bob albums create`, the registry, the cutover), which is
still in progress. Bank import (bob-cli-kd.4) has landed. Recurring charges stay out of
bank month notes as records; transactions remain bank rows.

task_type_fields.proposal: A bank/subscriptions album of discretionary keep-or-cancel charges, seeded from old_recur.md, linked from bank rows, with bob bank check proposing price changes and new subscription candidates.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bank epic plan files it as a task, not a phase, because it depends on the separate albums epic bob-cli-k3, which is still in progress.

issue.creation_reason: The bank epic (bob-cli-kd) deliberately left the subscriptions album as a follow-up blocked on the albums epic; bob-cli-kd.7 proposed it at wrap-up.
